embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Disability support

# Enhanced Home Personal Care (HPC+)

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/o0cdiebU*

Support frail or homebound seniors who require assistance with activities of daily living, and/or general support with routine tasks in the community.

**Who it targets:** Persons with disabilities, Seniors
**Citizenship:** SG, PR
**Keywords:** Home Care, Referral required, Seniors

## About this support
Provided by trained care professionals to assist seniors and their caregivers with:

- Personal care needs
  - Activities of Daily Living (e.g. showering, feeding)
  - Mind stimulating activities
  - Simple maintenance exercises prescribed by physiotherapist, occupational therapist, or speech therapist
  - Elder-sitting and respite for caregivers
- General support with routine tasks (e.g. regular check-ins, medication reminders, help with errands)
- Monitoring and responding to falls 24/7 using digital devices the client has installed at home
- Household chores (e.g. sweeping floors, cleaning fans and windows, and washing toilets)

## Who is this for?
Senior who:

- Requires personal services to continue living well at home
- Is a Singapore Citizen (SC), Permanent Resident (PR) or foreigner

Caregiver who:

- Needs support in their caregiving duties
- Is a Singapore Citizen (SC), Permanent Resident (PR) or foreigner

## How to apply?
- You will need to get a referral from a hospital, polyclinic or GP who is familiar with your loved ones’ condition and needs.
- You may also contact the service provider for a discussion. Visit the [Agency for Integrated Care (AIC)’s website](https://www.aic.sg/Care-Services/Enhanced-Home-Personal-Care) to search for service providers by** **postal code, address or your device’s current location.
- For further assistance, contact the AIC at [1800 650 6060](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/SVC-HPCSH/home-personal-care-hpc), email [enquiries@aic.sg](mailto:enquiries@aic.sg) or walk into a nearby [AIC Link](https://aic.sg/Contact-Us).

## What to expect?
- Subsidies are available depending on the [means-test](https://www.aic.sg/care-services/home-personal-care#faq) result.
  - Only applicable to SC and PR
- Applicants for care services need to fulfil the services’ eligibility criteria and providers’ service boundaries, if any, and enrolments are subject to availability of vacancies.

- Is a Singapore Citizen (SC), Permanent Resident (PR) or foreigner

# Enhancement for Active Seniors (Private Housing): EASE (Private) 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/nzWStXJo*

Provides subsidies to Singapore Citizen seniors living in private properties, for the installation of senior-friendly fittings.

## Highlights
- EASE (Private) will be in rolled out in phases from 1 April 2026, prioritising households with older seniors first
- Apply via EASE (Private) portal

**Who it targets:** Persons with disabilities, Seniors
**Keywords:** Seniors, Subsidies

## About this support
- EASE (Private) provides subsidies for the installation of senior-friendly fittings in private properties, to improve the mobility and safety of seniors within their homes.
- Eligible households will each receive $1,200 in vouchers that can be used to subsidise 75% of the cost of selected senior-friendly fittings purchased from appointed contractors. The household will only need to pay the remaining 25%.
- The seven senior-friendly fittings and their prices are as follows:

**Prices (after GST)**
**Prices after 75% subsidy**
Single-Step Ramp
$283.40
$70.85
Handrail
$632.20
$158.05
Grab Bars
First  set of 8 for combined toilet/bathroom or 10 pcs for separate toilet/bathroom
$523.20
$130.80
Second set onwards 6 pcs
$305.20
$76.30
Home Fire Alarm Device
$119.90
$29.98
Bidet Spray
$65.40
$16.35
Slip-Resistant Treatment to Existing Toilet Flooring*
*The treatment is for size up to 3.5sqm. For non-standard bathroom sizes larger than 3.5 sqm, further assessment will be done during site survey by contractors.
$239.80
$59.95
Shower Seat
$305.20
$76.30

## Who is this for?
EASE (Private) is available to private property households with at least one Singaporean household member aged:

1. 65 years old and above; or

1. Between 60 and 64 years old requiring assistance with at least one of the Activities of Daily Living (ADL)*

*ADL refers to daily self-care activities, including washing/bathing, dressing, feeding, toileting, mobility and transferring.

Seniors aged 60 to 64 must submit a Functional Assessment Report endorsed by a qualified assessor, such as a doctor, registered nurse, or registered physiotherapist/occupational therapist.

## How to apply?
Applications for EASE (Private) will be rolled out in phases (based on age of seniors in the household in 2026):

**When to Apply**
**Who Can Apply**
**From 1 Apr 2026 onwards**
Households with seniors aged 80 and above
Households with seniors aged 60 and above who require assistance with at least one of the Activities of Daily Living (ADL)
**From 1 Jul 2026 onwards**
Households with seniors aged 70 and above
**From 1 Oct 2026 onwards**
Households with seniors aged 65 and above

Letters and SMSes will be progressively sent to eligible households to apply for EASE (Private).

You can apply via BCA’s [EASE (Private) Portal](https://go.gov.sg/ease-private).

Seniors aged 60 to 64 who requires assistance for one or more of the Activities of Daily Living (ADL) must submit a [Functional Assessment Report](https://www.aic.sg/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Functional-Assessment-Report.pdf) endorsed by a qualified assessor, such as a doctor, registered nurse or registered physiotherapist/occupational therapist.

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://go.gov.sg/ease-feedback)

## Phone number
If you require assistance with the application, you may visit any Community Centre (CC) or ServiceSG Centre. You may also call BCA's hotline  [1800-342-5222](tel:1800-342-5222).

If you wish to obtain hard copy EASE (Private) vouchers, you may visit any Community Centre islandwide and they would assist you to print the vouchers.

Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Disability support, Financial support and benefits, Housing and shelters

# Seniors' Mobility and Enabling Fund

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/SMF*

Provides subsidies to seniors for mobility and assistive devices or home healthcare items.

## Highlights
- Up to 90% subsidy for mobility and assistive devices (e.g. wheelchairs, hearing aids)
- Up to 80% subsidies for home healthcare items (e.g. milk feeds, adult diapers)
- Approach your therapist or AIC directly to apply

**Who it targets:** Persons with disabilities, Seniors
**Keywords:** Assistive devices, Home healthcare, Seniors

## About this support
To support ageing in place, you may apply for the following subsidies for seniors who live at home:

- Subsidies of up to 90% for approved mobility and assistive devices (e.g. mobility aids such as walking/quad stick, wheelchair, geriatric chair, commodes, pressure relief mattress/cushions, hospital beds, spectacles, hearing aids, etc.)
- Subsidies of up to 80% for approved home healthcare items (e.g. milk feeds, diapers, etc.)

## Who is this for?
- 60 years old and above
- Singapore Citizen or PR
- Monthly household income per capita of less than or equal to $4,800 (or property annual value of $21,000 or below for households with no income)
- Pass a [means-test](https://aic.sg/Financial-Assistance/Seniors-Mobility-and-Enabling-Fund---Mobility-and-Assistive-Devices#faq) for Intermediate and Long-Term Care (ILTC) services
- Seniors and persons with disabilities will be served under one scheme and agency throughout their lifetime
- If the individual has tapped on Assistive Technology Fund (ATF)^ before the age of 60, they will continue to be served by ATF throughout their lifetime and not SMF
- If the individual has not tapped on ATF subsidies before the age of 60, they would be served by SMF throughout their lifetime
- Individuals can approach their care provider, e.g. hospitals, community care organisations, social service agencies, to enquire about their eligibility for the schemes
- They may also approach the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) if they are not currently receiving support from any care provider

^ATF provides subsidies for persons with disabilities (PWDs) to purchase the assistive technology devices to enable independent living

Additional criteria for assistive devices:

- Assessed by a qualified assessor to require the device
- Must not reside in a nursing home or sheltered home

Additional criteria for motorised devices:

- Must not have a full-time caregiver or domestic worker
- Unable to use a manual wheelchair independently
- Assessed to be mentally and physically able to safely use the motorised device

Additional criteria for home healthcare items:

- Must not be a current recipient of subsidies for the same items
- Must be receiving Home Nursing, Home Medical, Home Palliative Care, or Day Hospice services

## How to apply?
You can apply:

- via the therapist or social worker at the hospital, day rehabilitation centre, or senior care centre from which your loved one is receiving care
- online [using Singpass](https://for.sg/smf-application-using-singpass) or [without Singpass](https://for.sg/smf-application-not-using-singpass)
- By mailing the [completed application form for assistive device or mobility device](http://edge.sitecorecloud.io/agencyforinb6cc-agencyforin73f5-production08ac-d178/media/agency-for-integrated-care/Files/Financial-Assistance/SMF-Application-Form.pdf) and supporting documents to Seniors' Mobility and Enabling Fund (SMF), No. 7 Maxwell Road #04-01, MND Complex Annex B, Singapore 069111

You'll need to provide:

- Copy of Applicant's NRIC (front and back) or a copy of the digital NRIC available on SingPass
- For first time application for motorised device, doctor memo or [Need for Assessment form](https://edge.sitecorecloud.io/agencyforinb6cc-agencyforin73f5-production08ac-d178/media/agency-for-integrated-care/Files/Financial-Assistance/Cerification-of-Medical-Need-Form.pdf) indicating need for motorised device must be submitted.
- Copies of medical reports, if available
- Copies of financial assistance documents, if available

## Where to go
[Visit the AIC Link branch nearest to you](https://www.aic.sg/about-us/aic-link)

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.aic.sg/financial-assistance/seniors-mobility-enabling-fund)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.aic.sg/About-Us/Contact-Us-Form)

## Phone number
AIC Hotline: [1800 650 6060](tel:1800-650-6060)

title: CPF Nomination
description: Allows you to decide what happens to your CPF savings after your death.
embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Legacy planning, Retirement and legacy planning

# CPF Nomination

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/SVC-CPFN*

Allows you to decide what happens to your CPF savings after your death.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG, PR
**Keywords:** Advance Care Planning, Free

## About this support
A CPF nomination allows you to decide:

- Who will receive your CPF savings (your “nominee”)
- The percentage of your CPF savings each nominee should receive
- CPF savings **cannot be distributed by a will **as CPF savings do not form part of your estate. This arrangement **protects your CPF savings from creditor claims** on any outstanding debts you may have and preserves your savings fully for your nominees.

Your CPF nomination will cover:

- CPF savings in your Ordinary, Special, MediSave and Retirement Accounts
- CPF LIFE premium balance
- Your discounted Singtel shares (if any)

Your CPF nomination does not cover:

- Properties bought using your CPF savings
- Payout from the Dependants' Protection Scheme (DPS)
- Investments under CPF Investment Scheme (CPFIS)

## Who is this for?
To make a CPF nomination, you must:

- Be a CPF member
- Be aged 16 years and above
- Have the mental capacity to make your own decisions

You can **nominate any person or legal entity*** to be the beneficiary of your CPF savings.

*An entity that is capable of receiving monies in its own right.

## How to apply?
You can:

- Apply [online](http://cpf.gov.sg/MakeCPFNOM) using your Singpass
- [Make an appointment](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/appt/oas/form) to apply in person at any CPF service centre if you are unable to find two witnesses
- [Book an appointment](https://www.booking.gov.sg/public/services/G4x7rneZ/list) to visit a [ServiceSG Centre](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/find-a-service/life-planning-service/) for in-person guidance on your online nomination application. Click [here](https://www.psd.gov.sg/servicesg/) for the list of ServiceSG Centres and their operating hours

**For online application**

You will need to have:

**Your nominees’ particulars**

1. Full Name
2. NRIC or Foreign Identification Number (FIN)
3. Mailing Address (for foreigners)
4. Email Address (optional)

**Two witnesses’ particulars**

1. Full Name
2. NRIC
3. Email address and/or Singapore-registered mobile phone number
4. Cannot be a nominee
5. He/she cannot be a nominee and must be at least 21 years of age

Upon submission of your nomination,** inform your witnesses to log in **[here](http://cpf.gov.sg/witnessNOM)** within 7 calendar days to witness your nomination using their Singpass.**

**For in-person application**

You will need to bring along and prepare:

- A copy of your NRIC/passport
- Your nominee(s)' NRIC number or Foreign Identification Number (FIN), email (optional), and mailing address (for foreigners)

As CPF Board's customer service executives or ServiceSG staff are acting as your witnesses, you do not need to prepare your witnesses' particulars.

## What to expect?
If your nominee falls into the following categories, here is what to expect:

**Below 18 Years Old**
The monies will be held in trust by the Public Trustee until your nominee turns 18.
**Unable To Make Decisions Independently**
The monies will be handled by their court appointed deputy.
**Bankrupt**
The monies belonging to the undischarged bankrupt nominee, will be transferred to the Official Assignee.

To allow your CPF savings to be distributed swiftly according to your wishes when you pass on, it is important to **review your CPF nomination regularly**, especially at key milestones (e.g.):

- Starting Work
- Marriage*
- Childbirth
- Divorce
- Death of a nominee
- When you reach your golden years**

*Your nomination will be revoked upon marriage, and you should make a new nomination.

**Review your nomination and consider your current family circumstances, such as which family member may need your savings more.

embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving support, Disability support, Legacy planning, Retirement and legacy planning

# Application for Deceased's Unnominated CPF Monies 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/nywYq9hc*

Distribution of the un-nominated Central Provident Fund (CPF) monies of the Deceased Member in accordance with the relevant written law.

## Highlights
- CPF money of the deceased without a valid nomination is forwarded to the Public Trustee’s Office for administration 

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** CPF, CPF un-nominated monies

## About this support
- The un-nominated Central Provident Fund (CPF) monies of the Deceased Member can be distributed according to the applicable intestacy laws.
- If the beneficiaries include minors, the Public Trustee’s Office can hold the money in trust for them until they reach the maturity age of 21 years old.

## Who is this for?
Next-of-kin of deceased CPF member who wish to make a claim.

## How to apply?
- Apply online via the “Deceased’s un-nominated CPF / Baby Bonus / Edusave / PSEA” option at [Public Trustee's Office (PTO) E-Services](https://eservices.mlaw.gov.sg/pto) using your Singpass.
  If you are ineligible to apply for a Singpass, you may apply for a login ID and password [here](https://eservices.mlaw.gov.sg/pto). Select 'Login' and choose 'Register as Individual' from the dropdown menu.

- Please refer to [Annex A](https://pto.mlaw.gov.sg/files/Information_Page/AnnexA_Muslims_Oct20.pdf) (for Muslims) and [Annex B](https://pto.mlaw.gov.sg/files/Information_Page/AnnexB_NonMuslims_Oct20.pdf) (for non-Muslims) for documents required.
  - If the deceased was a Muslim, you will need to apply for the Certificate of inheritance via [Syariah Court ](http://www.syariahcourt.gov.sg).
- You may attach the required documents in your online submission, send via e-services or post to PTO at the following address: 
 
  Public Trustee’s Office 
  The URA Centre (East Wing) 
  45 Maxwell Road, #07-11 
  Singapore 069118
  - Please indicate the case reference number and NRIC of the deceased on your supporting documents

You will be assigned a case officer after you have filed your online application. Please inform your case officer if you do not possess some of the required documents. Your case officer will advise you on what to do after you have submitted your online application.

## Where to go
Ministry of Law Services Centre 
45 Maxwell Road 
#07-11 The URA Centre (East Wing) 
Singapore 069118

## Agency website
[View more details](https://pto.mlaw.gov.sg/deceased-cpf-estate-monies/information-for-next-of-kin-cpf-monies/)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://go.gov.sg/mlaw-enquiry-form)

## Phone number
Ministry of Law Hotline: [1800 225 5529](tel:18002255529)
For overseas callers, please use [+65 6225 5529](tel:62255529)

Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Disability support, Family, parenting and relationships, Financial support and benefits

# Dependant's Protection Scheme (DPS)

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/DPS*

Term life insurance scheme, solely administered by Great Eastern Life that provides basic financial protection for you and your family in the event of death, terminal illness or total permanent disability.

## Highlights
- Provides cash payout to get through the first few years should the insured member meet an untimely death, suffer from terminal illness or total permanent disability
- Processing of claim application generally takes 7 working days upon the Great Eastern Life's receipt of requested documents

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** Insurance, PWDs

## About this support
**Insured CPF Members up to age 60**

- Maximum sum assured of up to $70,000

**Insured CPF Members above age 60 and up to age 65**

- Maximum sum assured of up to $55,000

## Who is this for?
- Automatic inclusion of DPS coverage for Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident between age 21 and 65 upon a valid CPF working contribution.
- DPS claim payout is made to:
  - Next-of-kin/DPS nominee of policyholder who is deceased, or
  - DPS policyholder who is certified by a registered medical practitioner under the Medical Registration Act to be suffering from:
    - Terminal illness: an illness that is likely to result in the death of the insured CPF member within 12 months
    - Total permanent disability: the inability to take part in any employment permanently, or the total permanent loss of physical functions of any of the following:
      - Both eyes, or
      - Two limbs, or
      - One eye and one limb

## How to apply?
- For CPF members between age 16 and 65 and have not been automatically covered by DPS, you can [apply to join DPS with Great Eastern Life directly](https://www.greateasternlife.com/content/dam/corp-site/great-eastern/sg/gels-ftrp-imc-cm/life-insurance-/dependants-protection-scheme/proposal-for-dps.pdf).

**Claim on death grounds**

Next-of-kins/DPS nominee of policyholder can contact [Great Eastern Life](https://greateasternlife.com/DPS) directly for details of claim application forms and supporting documents required.

**Claim on medical grounds**

- DPS and either Home Protection Scheme (HPS) or withdraw CPF due to reduced life expectancy, or both:
  - Submit your application to the CPF Board directly via the [CPF website](https://cpf.gov.sg/applyrleandclaimhpsdps). The claim application for DPS will be forwarded to Great Eastern Life for their concurrent assessment.
- DPS only:
  - Contact [Great Eastern Life](https://greateasternlife.com/DPS) directly for details of claim application forms and supporting documents required.

## Where to go
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us)
Note: By appointment only

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/account-services/providing-for-your-loved-ones/insuring-to-protect-your-dependants)

## Email / Form
[Write to us](https://cpf.gov.sg/writetous)

## Phone number
CPF Hotline: [1800-227-1188](tel:1800-227-1188)

# Community Outreach Teams (CREST)

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/SVC-COTC*

Listens to your concerns and provides support such as therapy, as your in-person First Stop for Mental Health.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG, PR, OTHERS
**Keywords:** Caregiver support

## About this support
You can approach over 100 community mental health teams in the community islandwide such as CREST, providing the following support:

- Promote early recognition of signs and symptoms of mental health conditions and/or dementia.
- Improve mental health conditions and/or dementia literacy by organising targeted outreach events and activities to provide mental health and/or dementia information and education to residents and caregivers in the region.
- Provide psychosocial intervention such as techniques to reduce the risk of escalation of mental health needs.
- Provide collaborative and coordinated care for clients and caregivers through a case management approach.
- Work in partnership with health and community care partners and key stakeholders to co-manage and support persons with mental health conditions and dementia in the community.

These community mental health teams are developed under the Community Mental Health Masterplan driven by the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC), together with the Ministry of Health (MOH). The teams are fully funded by the government and there is no out-of-pocket cost.

## Who is this for?
Any individual who is:

- At risk of mental health conditions and/or dementia, and their caregivers
- Aged 18 and above

## How to apply?
- Call or email the providers to make an appointment. Visit [AIC’s website](https://aic.sg/Care-Services/Community-Mental-Health-Services) to search for service providers by** **postal code, address or your device’s current location.
- If you are already seeing a General Practitioner (GP) or Polyclinic doctor, you may approach them for support.

## What to expect?
- Applicants may need to fulfil the services’ in-take criteria and providers’ service boundaries, if any.

title: Advance Care Planning (ACP)
description: Helps communicate your values and how they shape your healthcare preferences to your loved ones and healthcare team.
embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Legacy planning, Retirement and legacy planning

# Advance Care Planning (ACP)

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/SVC-ACP*

Helps communicate your values and how they shape your healthcare preferences to your loved ones and healthcare team.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG, PR, OTHERS
**Keywords:** Advance Care Planning, Fees payable

## About this support
Advance Care Planning (ACP) is an ongoing process of planning and preparing for your future health and personal care. It includes conversations about your:

- personal beliefs
- values
- healthcare preferences

These will be shared with your loved ones and healthcare team.

Having a quality ACP ensures that this process is person-centred, informed and guided. In the event that you lose the capacity to make decisions or speak for yourself, the ACP will help your loved ones and healthcare team act in your best interests based on your prior expressed wishes.

## Who is this for?
- For any individuals aged 21 years old* and above who has the capacity to make their own decisions.
- Includes people who are healthy and living with chronic or any other medical conditions.

ACP is particularly important for people who are living with a health condition. You can consult your regular doctor, especially if you have chronic conditions (e.g. diabetes, heart disease, chronic kidney disease) or any other medical concerns.

*For individuals below 21 years old and living with a health condition, please approach your healthcare team if you are interested to find out more about ACP.

## How to apply?
You can:

1. Use the [myACP online service](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/find-a-service/acp/)

Complete your ACP without having to speak to an ACP facilitator. You can use the [myACP online service](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/find-a-service/acp/) if you:

- have a Singpass account
- are at least 21 years old
- do not have any existing serious illness
- do not have a Preferred Plan of Care (PPC) ACP or Disease Specific (DS) ACP

Once you’ve completed the online form, your NHS will receive digital invitations. They’ll be notified via SMS, and must accept or reject their appointment by logging in to My Legacy with their Singpass. Your ACP will automatically be registered once all your NHS have accepted their appointments.

1. Book an appointment with an ACP facilitator

[Visit an ACP service provider](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/listing/acp-providers/results) if you:

- prefer to have a conversation with an ACP facilitator and be guided
- have an existing serious illness*

Your ACP will be registered in the National Electronic Health Records (NEHR) upon completing all discussions with your facilitator. Some service providers may charge a nominal fee. Please check with the respective organisation for details.

* Serious illnesses include: Cancer, Stroke, End Stage Renal Failure (ESRF), Severe Liver Disease, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), Congestive Heart Failure (CHF), Dementia, and Chronic Neurological Disease.

1. [Book an appointment](https://www.booking.gov.sg/public/services/G4x7rneZ/list) or visit a [ServiceSG Centre](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/find-a-service/life-planning-service/) today for in-person guidance and assistance for your application.

You may also refer to [this website](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/end-of-life-planning/advance-care-planning/) for more information on steps to prepare your ACP.

## What to expect?
- You will need to appoint a Nominated Healthcare Spokesperson (NHS) who is responsible for speaking on your behalf about your healthcare preferences when you are no longer able to do so. In such situations, the healthcare team will consult your NHS and discuss your care plan.
- After completing your ACP, it will be available on the National Electronic Health Record (NEHR), where your healthcare team can access and refer to your ACP to prepare your care plan.

embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving support, Disability support, Financial support and benefits, Healthcare and well-being, Retirement and legacy planning

# Matched MediSave Scheme

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/LrEfS3Nx*

Helps eligible Singapore Citizens to strengthen MediSave adequacy by matching cash top-ups made to their MediSave Accounts (MA).

## Highlights
- Dollar-for-dollar matching grant on cash top-ups to your MA of up to $1,000 per year
- Build MA savings to help pay approved medical expenses and insurance premiums, e.g. for MediShield Life
- Earn risk-free CPF interest rates of up to 6% per annum on cash top-ups and matching grant 

**Who it targets:** Seniors
**Keywords:** Budget 2025, Medical bills, Seniors

## About this support
- The Government will match every dollar of cash top-ups made to the MA of eligible beneficiaries, up to $1,000 per year, starting from January 2026, for a period of five years

- The matching grant will automatically be credited to the MA of the eligible member at the beginning of the following year, i.e. from 2027

- Eligible beneficiaries will enjoy interest rates of up to 6% per annum on the cash top-ups and matching grant

- Cash top-ups that attract the Matched MediSave Scheme matching grant will not qualify for tax relief

## Who is this for?
- Singapore Citizen
- Between 55 and 70 (inclusive) as of 31 December of the year
- Does not own more than 1 property
- Annual Value of residence not more than $21,000
- Average monthly income not more than $4,000
- MA balance less than half the current Basic Healthcare Sum

## How to apply?
- No application is required
- Eligibility is automatically assessed annually at the beginning of the year, starting from January 2026
  - If you are eligible, CPF Board will notify you via email or post
  - To receive the matching grant, you need to [receive cash top-ups in your MA](http://www.cpf.gov.sg/topupmedisave) within the year that you are eligible for Matched MediSave Scheme

## Where to go
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us)

Note: Please [book an appointment](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/appt/oas/form) before making a visit.

## Agency website
[View more details](http://www.cpf.gov.sg/mmss)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/contact-us)

## Phone number
CPF hotline (within Singapore): [1800-227-1188](tel:1800-222-3399) 
CPF hotline (from overseas): [+65-6227-1188](tel:+65-6222-3399)

[Book an appointment](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us) to avoid waiting on the line.

Domains: Caregiving support, Disability support, Financial support and benefits

# Assistive Technology Fund (ATF)

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/ATF*

Provides subsidies for persons with disabilities (PWDs) to purchase assistive technology devices to enable independent living. The devices should aid early intervention, education, training, employment, therapy, rehabilitation and/or independence in daily living for PWDs.

## Highlights
- Subsidy of up to 90% of the cost of the required assistive technology device (lifetime cap of $40,000)
- Apply through a therapist or social worker at public hospitals or social service agencies

**Who it targets:** Persons with disabilities, Seniors
**Keywords:** Assistive devices, PWDs, Subsidies

## About this support
- Subsidy of up to 90% of the cost of the required assistive technology device (lifetime cap of $40,000)
- Subsidy amount is determined according to the applicant's monthly household income
- Funds can be used to buy, replace, upgrade, or repair assistive technology devices
- The Fund does not support consumables. The Fund will cover medical devices (e.g. oxygen concentrators and suction pumps) and spectacles for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents at or above age 60, who remain served by ATF.

## Who is this for?
- Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents
- Have a permanent disability based on any one of the following:
  - Physical Disability: Requires some assistance with at least 1 of the 6 Activities of Daily Living due to physical impairment
  - A visual impairment: Moderate visual impairment or worse in the better eye
  - A hearing impairment: Moderate hearing loss or worse in the better ear
  - Intellectual disability
  - Autism

Proof of disability must be provided using the [Disability Verification Form](https://www.enablingguide.sg/disability-verification) completed by a relevant registered healthcare professional.

Undergone qualified assessor’s assessment to determine the need and type of device(s)

- Monthly Per Capita Household Income of $4,800 and below
- Annual Value (AV) of residence reflected on NRIC of $21,000 and below for households with no income

**Note for Singaporean and Permanent Resident Seniors:**

Subject to eligibility,

(a) Singaporean and Permanent Resident seniors who have not tapped on ATF before the age of 60 will be supported by the Seniors' Mobility and Enabling Fund (SMF). Please apply to SMF.

(b) Singaporean and Permanent Resident seniors who have tapped on ATF before the age of 60 will be supported by ATF throughout their lifetime.

## How to apply?
- Approach a therapist or a social worker from public hospitals or social service agencies to assess and assist you to submit the application
  - If you are not currently under the care of any public hospitals or social service agencies, you may approach a polyclinic to obtain a referral letter to a public hospital for an assessment and thereafter submit the application.
- Before meeting your touchpoints, all applicants are encouraged to check if your disability status has already been verified by logging into [SupportGoWhere](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/grants/pwdr/apply) with your Singpass. If you do not have a verified disability status, the touchpoint's registered healthcare professional will be able to guide you with the disability verification.
- Means testing is required and this will be assisted by the social worker at the public hospitals or social service agencies.

## Where to go
[Enabling Village](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=159053)
[20 Lengkok Bahru ](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=159053)
[#01-01, Singapore 159053](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=159053)

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.enablingguide.sg/im-looking-for-disability-support/assistive-technology/assistive-technology-fund)

## Email / Form
[contactus@sgenable.sg](mailto:contactus@sgenable.sg)

## Phone number
SG Enable Hotline: [1800-8585-885](tel:1800-8585-885)

title: Settling Outstanding Tax Matters and Bills for a Deceased Person
description: Enables executors or administrators to settle the deceased's taxes and outstanding debts using the estate's funds before distribution to beneficiaries.
highlights: Settle the deceased's taxes and debts using the estate's funds
embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving support, Disability support

# Settling Outstanding Tax Matters and Bills for a Deceased Person

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/P3m8eAvW*

Enables executors or administrators to settle the deceased's taxes and outstanding debts using the estate's funds before distribution to beneficiaries.

## Highlights
- Settle the deceased's taxes and debts using the estate's funds

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** Resources and Support

## About this support
Executors or administrators of a deceased can act on the deceased’s following matters:

- Filing personal income tax for the deceased on the income earned up to the date of death.
- Filing estate or trust income tax for the deceased on the income. Estate income refers to the income generated by the deceased’s assets after date of death, during the administration of the estate. Trust income refers to the income from assets held in trust.
- Settling the taxes and other bills such as loans, funeral expenses and medical bills from the estate funds of the deceased before distribution to deceased’s beneficiaries.

## Who is this for?
- Executors or administrators of a deceased’s estate who are responsible for settling outstanding taxes, debts and liabilities.
- Remember, the executor or administrator must ensure all outstanding taxes, loans, funeral expenses, and medical bills are paid from the deceased's estate before distributing the remaining assets to the beneficiaries.

## How to apply?
File personal income tax for the deceased
Provide IRAS with the following details via [myTaxMail](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/portal/correspondence/mytax-mail):
- Name, address and identification number of the legal personal representative who is handling the affairs of the deceased;
- Copy of the death certificate;
- Copy of the Grant of Probate/Letter of Administration, if available;
- Income details from all sources, up to the date of death (please specify the breakdown for each income source); and
- Type and amount of tax relief available/applicable to reduce the tax burden.
File an Income Tax Return for Estate or Trust Income
- Download and complete the Request Form for Form T from [IRAS's website](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/other-taxes/trusts/filing-estate-trust-income-tax-(form-t)/form-t).
- Email the completed form to [trust@iras.gov.sg ](mailto:trust@iras.gov.sg)and IRAS will provide you with:
  - a Trust Reference Number
  - a copy of Form T to complete
- Mail the completed Form T to this address: The Comptroller of Income Tax, 55 Newton Road, Singapore 307987.

## Where to go
55 Newton Road, Revenue House, Singapore 307987

## Agency website
[View more details ](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/my-situation/my-family-member-has-passed-away)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us)

## Phone number
For guidance, consult a lawyer or contact IRAS directly at [1800 356 8300](tel:1800-356-8300) or visit the IRAS office at 55 Newton Road, Revenue House, Singapore 307987, from Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.  

If you need to speak with a tax officer, you are encouraged to [make an appointment](https://eappointment.iras.gov.sg/eappt/) at least 2 working days in advance.

Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Disability support, Family, parenting and relationships, Financial support and benefits, Healthcare and well-being

# MediFund

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/MEDIFUND*

For Singaporeans who face difficulties with remaining medical bills after receiving government subsidies and other means of payment.

## Highlights
- Assistance with medical bills
- Amount of assistance depends on the applicant's circumstances and bills incurred
- Apply through Medical Social Workers at the institution where you received treatment

**Who it targets:** Low-income
**Keywords:** Cash assistance, Lower-income, Medical bills

## About this support
The actual amount of assistance you receive depends on you and your family members' financial, health and social circumstances, as well as the size of the medical bill incurred.

## Who is this for?
To apply for MediFund assistance, you must:

- be a Singapore Citizen;
- be a subsidised patient;
- have received or require treatment from a MediFund-approved institution; and
- be having difficulties paying for your healthcare bills after Government subsidies and other means including MediShield Life, MediSave, and cash.

Your application will be assessed holistically, taking into consideration you and your family’s financial, health and social circumstances.

## How to apply?
- You or your family can approach the Medical Social Workers at the MediFund-approved institution at which you had treatment
- In addition to MediFund, they will also be able to explore other possible financing means with you

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.moh.gov.sg/managing-expenses/schemes-and-subsidies/medifund#What is MediFund?)

## Phone number
MediFund applications are administered directly by the MediFund-approved institution. You may wish to first contact the Medical Social Services Department or Business Office Department of the institution you are seeking care at for further assistance.

MOH Hotline: [6325 9220](tel:63259220)

# Pioneer Generation Package 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/n4iFaG9r*

Special recognition to our Pioneer Generation through a package that assures them of affordable healthcare.

## Highlights
- Provides our Pioneer Generation with a special package that ensures affordable healthcare
- Benefits include life-long monthly cash assistance and healthcare subsidies 

**Who it targets:** Persons with disabilities, Seniors
**Keywords:** Pioneer generation, Seniors, Subsidies

## About this support
Provides the following benefits to support healthcare for Pioneers:

MediSave Top-Ups
- Annual MediSave top-ups for life, ranging from $300 to $1,200 depending on birth cohort, to offset premiums for MediShield Life, ElderShield and CareShield Life.
- Additional MediSave top-ups of $50 to $200 will be disbursed from 2021 to 2025 for older Pioneers (i.e. those aged 82 and above in 2021) with serious pre-existing conditions who are paying additional premiums.
Additional Outpatient Care Subsidies
- Additional subsidies for outpatient care at polyclinics, public Specialist Outpatient Clinics and Community Health Assist Scheme clinics.
Special MediShield Life Premium Subsidies
- Supports Pioneers in paying their MediShield Life premiums with special premium subsidies of up to 60%.
- Combined with the MediSave top-ups ($300 - $1,200), Pioneers born in 1934 or earlier will see their MediShield Life premiums fully covered, and Pioneers born from 1935 to 1949 will have about two-thirds of their MediShield Life premiums covered.
Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme
- Grants life-long cash assistance of $100 each month for those needing permanent assistance with at least 3 out of 6 of the following Activities of Daily Living:
  - Eating
  - Bathing
  - Dressing
  - Transferring
  - Toileting
  - Walking or moving around
[Incentives have ceased]
CareShield Life Additional Participation Incentives
- Provides participation incentives (totalling $3,000) to encourage Pioneers to join CareShield Life by 31 Dec 2024, in addition to any other premium subsidies seniors may receive.

If you would like [more details on the above benefits as well as other useful information about this Package, please refer here.](https://www.moh.gov.sg/healthcare-schemes-subsidies/pioneer-generation-package)

## Who is this for?
- Singapore Citizen
- Born on or before 31 December 1949 and acquired citizenship on or before 31 December 1986
- Eligible applicants have been notified in 2014
- You may check your eligibility by:
  - Using the LifeSG app to view your Pioneer Generation e-card; or
  - Logging in to the Singpass mobile app to view your eligibility status

## How to apply?
- No application required
- Eligible individuals will receive the benefits automatically
- To apply for the Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme (PioneerDAS), visit [this site](https://www.aic.sg/financial-assistance/pioneer-generation-disability-assistance-scheme/) for more information

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.moh.gov.sg/healthcare-schemes-subsidies/pioneer-generation-package)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](mailto:contactus@pioneers.gov.sg)

## Phone number
For general enquiries on Pioneer Generation eligibility, MediSave top-up, and MediShield Life Subsidy: [1800-222-2888](tel:1800-222-2888)

For loss of Pioneer Generation Card, and other healthcare-related enquiries: [1800-650-6060](tel:1800-650-6060)

title: Deputyship
description: For persons who lack mental capacity and have not made a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) and/or have no donee to make certain decisions on their behalf.
embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving, Caregiving support, Disability support, Legacy planning, Retirement and legacy planning

# Deputyship

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/SVC-D*

For persons who lack mental capacity and have not made a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) and/or have no donee to make certain decisions on their behalf.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG, PR, OTHERS
**Keywords:** Mental incapacity

## About this support
- Deputyship is required if a person has lost mental capacity and did not appoint a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA)
- A deputy may be the patient's family member or friend

## Who is this for?
Persons who have been certified to have no mental capacity.

## How to apply?
[Find out more on how to apply for a deputyship](https://www.judiciary.gov.sg/family/deputyship)

## What to expect?
- You may apply to the court to seek a court order to be appointed as a Deputy.
- Anyone above 21 years of age can apply to be a Deputy. A Deputy is usually a family member or close friend who would act in the best interest of the person who lacks capacity.
- A doctor has to certify that the patient lacks mental capacity to make decisions due to an impairment of or disturbance in the functioning of the mind or brain
- The Family Courts hear all deputyship applications under the Mental Capacity Act
- Applicants may need to fulfil the services’ in-take criteria and providers’ service boundaries, if any.

# Professional Deputies and Donees Scheme

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/PDDS*

The scheme serves individuals who may not have suitable family members or friends to appoint as their proxy decision makers. Professionals may be appointed as proxy decision makers for these individuals for remuneration.

## Highlights
- Professional deputies have to pass a certification course and a list of stringent criteria (e.g.  no history of bankruptcy or criminal proceedings related to financial dishonesty) before they can be registered
- The professional deputies have to re-register every 2 years with the Office of the Public Guardian to ensure they still meet the stringent criteria
- The charges of the Professional Deputies vary depending on their professions and individual case requirements. Individuals may engage them to mutually agree on the fee charge

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** Advance Care Planning, Mental incapacity

## About this support
- Professionals registered under this scheme include lawyers, doctors, accountants, allied health professionals, nurses, and social workers
- Professional deputies apply to Court to act for individuals who lack mental capacity (known as 'P') on property &, affairs, and personal welfare matters
- Professional deputies provide a (i) P-focused plan and a (ii) Schedule of Assets as part of the application

## Who is this for?
- Persons who lack mental capacity (known as ‘P’) who do not have suitable family members or friends to be their proxy decision makers
- Individuals with mental capacity can also choose to make a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA), and appoint a Professional Deputy to act as a Donee for renumeration

## How to apply?
Members of the public who are keen to appoint a professional deputy/donee can approach any of the individuals on this [list of Registered Professional Deputies/Donees](https://www.msf.gov.sg/docs/default-source/opg/list_of_registered_professional_deputies.pdf?sfvrsn=83247f26_98) to enquire on their professional fees and to make an appointment.

## Where to go
[Family@Enabling Village 20 Lengkok Bahru, #04-02 Singapore 159053](https://onemap.gov.sg/?postal=159053)

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.msf.gov.sg/what-we-do/opg/about-PDD-scheme)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://ask.gov.sg/msf/questions/new?topic=MSF Office of the Public Guardian)

## Phone number
MSF Consolidated Hotline: [1800-111-2222](tel:18001112222) 
(To reach the Office of the Public Guardian, say "OPG" when prompted by the virtual assistant)

# My Legacy

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/SVC-ML*

Plan, store and share your legal, healthcare and estate matters securely with people you trust.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG
**Keywords:** Advance Care Planning

## About this support
- My Legacy is a trusted digital companion that makes planning easy and convenient.
- It uses technology to make it seamless to document and share your plans, so that you and your loved ones can spend the time focusing on the things that matter: celebrating your relationships, achieving your life goals, and leaving a lasting legacy.

## Who is this for?
- Individuals aged 30 and above who are interested to find out how they can start their legacy planning.

## How to apply?
- No application is needed
- [Find out more on how to start legacy planning](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/end-of-life-planning)

## What to expect?
- Consolidated information on legacy planning and services like applying for a Lasting Power of Attorney, Advance Care Planning
- [You can also download a copy of a deceased's digital death certificate from My Legacy if it is still within 30 days from the date of issuance.](https://mylegacy.life.gov.sg/find-a-service/download-death-or-stillbirth-certificate/)

# MediShield Life

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/MEDISHIELD*

A basic health insurance plan managed by the CPF Board to help pay for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatments.

## Highlights
- Lifetime coverage for all Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents regardless of age or health condition
- No application needed

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** CPF, Health Insurance, Medical bills

## About this support
- Provides [lifetime coverage](https://moh.gov.sg/home/our-healthcare-system/medishield-life/what-is-medishield-life/what-medishield-life-benefits) for hospital bills and selected outpatient treatments
- MediShield Life coverage is sized for subsidised treatment in public hospitals and pegged at B2/C-type wards
- If you choose to stay in an A/B1-type ward or in a private hospital, you are still covered by MediShield Life
  - However, your MediShield Life payout will cover only a proportion of your bill, and you would need to draw from MediSave and/or cash to pay the balance

## Who is this for?
- Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents

## How to apply?
No application is required

## Where to go
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us)

Note: By appointment only

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/healthcare-financing/medishield-life)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/contact-us)

## Phone number
Healthcare Hotline: [1800 222 3399](tel:1800-222-3399)

To avoid waiting on the line, you may book an appointment [here](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/appt/oas/form).

# MediSave

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/MEDISAVE*

A personal healthcare savings account that helps you pay for you and loved ones' healthcare expenses over your lifetime, especially when you retire and no longer have regular income.

## Highlights
- Covers selected medical, treatment and hospital expenses, up to the approved limits
- Covers for healthcare insurance premiums, rehabilitation and palliative care
- Applicable at all MediSave accredited Public Healthcare Institutions (PHIs)

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** CPF, Medical bills

## About this support
- MediSave pays for a variety of medical expenses such as selected outpatient treatments, day surgery and hospitalisation expenses
- It also covers the costs for your rehabilitation and palliative care
- You can also tap on your MediSave to pay for health insurance premiums for yourself and your loved ones

## Who is this for?
- You need to be a Singapore Citizen (SC) or Permanent Resident (PR)
- Your spouse, children and parents can be of any nationality, except grandparents and siblings who must be SC or PR

## How to apply?
- To use your MediSave, inform the Public Healthcare Institutions (PHIs) or Medical Institutions (MIs) where you are receiving treatment at, and you would like to use your MediSave to pay for your medical expenses
  - If this is your first time applying, you will need to sign the Medical Claims Authorisation Form (MCAF)
  - If you had previously given a standing authorisation for the use of MediSave, the MI will submit a claim on your behalf
- The PHI and/or MI will submit the medical claim on your behalf and payment from your healthcare plans will be made directly to them
- Upon approval of the claim, the Board and/or insurer will notify you accordingly

## Where to go
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us)
Note: By appointment only

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/healthcare-financing/using-your-medisave-savings)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/contact-us)

## Phone number
Healthcare Hotline: [1800 222 3399](tel:18002223399)

To avoid waiting on the line, you may book an appointment [here](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/appt/oas/form).

# Live Well, Age Well Programme

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/LWAWP*

The Live Well, Age Well programme is co-organised by HPB and PA to provide holistic activities to improve the physical, mental and social health of adults aged 50 and above.

## Highlights
- Discover free activities near you to stay healthy and active
- Download the Healthy 365 mobile app on Apple Store / Google Play

**Who it targets:** Seniors
**Keywords:** Resources and Support

## About this support
- As we age, staying healthy and active is important so you can continue doing the activities you love.
- The Live Well, Age Well programme features a wide range of FREE^ exciting activities in your neighbourhood to help you kickstart your healthy living journey.
- Activities are specially designed based on the needs of adults aged 50 years old and above, so as to help you improve your physical, mental and social health to continue doing what you love.
- These programmes are available at multiple locations near you, including Community Centres/Clubs, Residents’ Committee, Residents’ Network Centres, Senior Activity Centres. Some programmes (e.g. group exercise sessions and workshops) are also available online, so you can stay healthy in the comfort of your home.

^Except for subsidised health screening programmes under Live Assured.

## Who is this for?
- All Singapore residents aged 50 and above are welcome to join our Live Well, Age Well programme.
- There may be additional criteria for selected programmes.
- Visit [Live Well, Age Well website](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/160/AAP) for more information.

## How to apply?
**Step 1**: Download the Healthy 365 mobile app on Apple Store / Google Play.

**Step 2**: Create profile if you are a new user. Log in to your existing profile with your NRIC and registered phone number if you are an existing user.

**Step 3**: Tap on "Explore" and select "Events" to view upcoming events.

**Step 4**: Search "Active Ageing" to filter for Live Well, Age Well programmes.

**Step 5**: Select the event you are interested in to view more details. Select "Book Now" to sign up.

You may also visit your nearest Community Clubs/Centres (CCs) or Residents’ Committees (RC)/Residents’ Network (RN) Centres for assistance.

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.healthhub.sg/programmes/160/AAP)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](mailto:HPB_mailbox@hpb.gov.sg)

## Phone number
HPB hotline: [1800 223 1313](tel:1800-223-1313)

embedding_text:

# Merdeka Generation Package 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/lceYNjsb*

Supporting Merdeka Generation seniors in their silver years by helping them to stay active, healthy and providing peace of mind over future healthcare costs.

## Highlights
- Provides various health-related benefits to support seniors’ ageing, such as additional Outpatient Care subsidies and additional MediShield (MSHL) premium subsidies

**Who it targets:** Seniors
**Keywords:** Seniors, Subsidies

## About this support
Provides the following benefits to support healthcare for Merdeka seniors:

Additional Outpatient Care Subsidies
Additional subsidies for outpatient care at polyclinics, public Specialist Outpatient Clinics and Community Health Assist Scheme clinics.
Additional MediShield Life Premium Subsidies
Provides an additional 5% subsidy for your annual premiums, increasing to 10% after turning 75 years old.
[Redemption has ended wef. 31 Dec 2023] 
$100 Passion Silver Card Top-Up
One-off $100 top-up for use on active ageing programmes, public transport, merchant benefits etc (redemption has ceased wef. 31 Dec 2023).
[Top-Up has ended] 
Annual MediSave top-ups of $200 (2019-2023)
$200 Medisave top-ups annually from 2019 to 2023. 

MediSave can be used to cover hospitalisation and treatment costs, pay various medical-related premiums etc.
[Incentives have ceased]
CareShield Life Additional Participation Incentives
Provides participation incentives (totalling $3,000 spread across 10 years) for seniors who join CareShield Life by 31 Dec 2024, in addition to any other premium subsidies seniors may receive.

If you would like [more details on the above benefits as well as other useful information about this Package, please refer here](https://go.gov.sg/mgpackage).

## Who is this for?
- Singapore Citizens who were:
  - born from 1 January 1950 to 31 December 1959; and became citizens on or before 31 December 1996, or

# Car Park Label Scheme

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/CPLS*

Provides two types of labels that allow drivers (Class 1) and passengers (Class 2) with medically certified mobility challenges to park at accessible spaces, so they can board or alight from their vehicles safely.

## Highlights
- Eligible drivers and passengers with mobility impairment can apply for a Car Park Label to use accessible lots

**Who it targets:** Persons with disabilities
**Keywords:** PWDs, Transport

## About this support
- Car park labels allow access to accessible lots for easier boarding and alighting for drivers and passengers with mobility impairment
- Each label can be used by the label holder only. Car park labels are not applicable to motorcycles
- Option for Social Service Agencies (SSAs) to obtain labels for vehicles providing dedicated transport to passengers with mobility impairment

## Who is this for?
- For Class 1: Drivers who are certified by Singapore registered medical professionals to require the use of bulky mobility aids and need to open the vehicle doors fully to board or alight from the vehicle.
- For Class 2: Passengers who are certified by a Singapore registered medical professionals as to require the use of bulky mobility aids and need to open the vehicle doors fully to board or alight from the vehicle.
- For Class 2 SSA: Social Service Agencies registered as NCSS Members providing dedicated transport to passengers with mobility impairment.

## How to apply?
For more information on the application process, please visit [Enabling Guide](https://www.enablingguide.sg/im-looking-for-disability-support/transport/car-park-label-scheme).

Pioneer and Merdeka Generation subsidies
embedding_text:
Domains: Caregiving support, Disability support, Family, parenting and relationships, Financial support and benefits, Healthcare and well-being

# MediShield Life Premium Subsidies 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/DKTZwVPL*

To keep MediShield Life premiums affordable, the Government provides several premium support measures, such as Premium Subsidies, Pioneer Generation Subsidies and Merdeka Generation Subsidies.

## Highlights
- Premium subsidies of up to 60%  
- Pioneer and Merdeka Generation subsidies 

**Who it targets:** Low-income, Seniors
**Keywords:** Health Insurance, Lower-mid income, Subsidies

## About this support
**Eligibility criteria for Premium Subsidies:**

- Premium Subsidies of up to 60% for eligible lower-to middle-income households
- Pioneer Generation Subsidies of between 40-60%, depending on age
- Merdeka Generation Subsidies of between 5%-10%, depending on age

As of 1 Apr 2025,

Household Monthly Income Per Person
Subsidy Range (tiered by age)
$0 - $1,500
25% - 60%
> $1,501 - $2,600
20% - 55%
> $2,601 - $3,600
15% - 40%

Note: The above subsidy rates apply to those living in property with an AV of $21,000 or less. Properties with an AV between $21,001 and $31,000 receive 10% less subsidies. Permanent Residents (PRs) receive half the subsidy rate applicable to Singapore Citizens (SCs). Those who live in residences with an AV above $31,000 or own multiple properties will not receive these subsidies.

**Eligibility for Pioneer Generation Subsidies:**

- Applicable for Pioneers, regardless of their household monthly income or the AV of their residence

**Eligibility for Merdeka Generation Subsidies:**

- Applicable for Merdeka Generation seniors, regardless of their household monthly income or the AV of their residence, on top of the Premium Subsidies that the seniors may be eligible for

Please [click here](https://www.moh.gov.sg/healthcare-schemes-subsidies/medishield-life/medishield-life-premiums-and-subsidies) for more information on Premium Subsidies, Pioneer Generation Subsidies and Merdeka Generation Subsidies.

## Who is this for?
Eligibility criteria for Premium Subsidies:

- Household monthly income per person of $3,600 or below; and
- Living in property with an Annual Value (AV) of $31,000 and below; and
- Not owning more than 1 property

## How to apply?
The subsidies that you are eligible for will be automatically applied to your MediShield Life premiums.

## Where to go
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/member/contact-us/visit-us)

Note: By appointment only

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.moh.gov.sg/healthcare-schemes-subsidies/medishield-life/medishield-life-premiums-and-subsidies)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/service/contact-us)

## Phone number
Healthcare Hotline: [1800-222-3399](tel:1800-222-3399)

To avoid waiting on the line, you may book an appointment [here](https://www.cpf.gov.sg/appt/oas/form).

embedding_text:
Domains: Citizenship and residency, Family, parenting and relationships, Financial support and benefits, Housing and shelters

# Housing Subsidy - Citizen Top-Up

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/IwOX3hng*

Provides a $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a family member becomes a Singapore Citizen.

## Highlights
- $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a household member acquires Singapore citizenship 
- Citizen Top-Up  is credited into CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible family members
- Can be used for repayment or redemption of housing loan, future HDB flat purchase or CPF withdrawal at age 55

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** CPF top-ups, Home ownership, Housing grants

## About this support
- $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible households when a qualifying member becomes a Singapore Citizen
- The subsidy is converted into equal shares and credited fully into the CPF Ordinary Accounts of eligible family members
- Only core flat owners can use their share of the CPF housing grants to pay for the flat e.g. loan repayment
- The Citizen Top-Up can be used for a lump sum repayment or full redemption of an HDB housing loan
- For housing loans from financial institutions, you may additionally use it for monthly instalments
  - You must clear all outstanding housing loan arrears before you can use the grant for the above purposes
- If you have any remaining Citizen Top-Up balance and no housing loan, you may use it to buy another HDB flat in the future, or to form part of the CPF funds available for withdrawal under CPF rules at age 55

## Who is this for?
- Households that have paid a $10,000 premium when buying a flat from HDB
- Households who received a reduced Family Grant for a resale flat, a Design Build and Sell Scheme flat or an Executive Condominium unit
- The Citizen Top-Up is granted when a Permanent Resident spouse, parent, child or sibling^ originally listed in the flat application obtains Singapore Citizenship, or when a Singapore Citizen child is born to the Singapore Citizen applicant and spouse originally listed in the flat application

^ For siblings, this qualification only applies to flats purchased as orphaned siblings or for families with a non-resident spouse.

## How to apply?
Submit your application online:

- Use the [Application for Citizen Top-up e-Service](https://services2.hdb.gov.sg//webapp/AB22AWTopUpGrantWeb/AB22PMain#) within 6 months of meeting the citizenship criteria

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/finances/citizen-topup)

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](http://go.gov.sg/hdb-write-to-us)

description: Eligible applicants can remain in Singapore for an extended period via a Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP).
embedding_text:
Domains: Citizenship and residency

# Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/L-TVP*

Eligible applicants can remain in Singapore for an extended period via a Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP).

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** OTHERS
**Keywords:** Families, Fees payable

## About this support
- Eligible foreigners can stay in Singapore for an extended period of time
- The LTVP will be issued digitally and can be viewed on the Singpass app or downloaded from [MyICA](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/icsbip) or via [FileSG](https://www.file.gov.sg/for-individuals)
- Singapore Citizens with foreign spouses may also be eligible for LTVP Plus (LTVP+), providing a longer period of residency and additional employment and healthcare benefits

## Who is this for?
The following applicant types are eligible to apply for LTVP:

- Spouse of a Singapore citizen (must be sponsored by the Singapore citizen spouse)^
- Foreign spouse of a Singapore Permanent Resident (must be sponsored by the Permanent Resident spouse)
- Unmarried child under 21, born within a legal marriage to / legally adopted by a Singapore citizen or Permanent Resident (must be sponsored by parents)
- Parent of a Singapore citizen or Permanent Resident (sponsor must be above 21)
- Graduate from an Institute of Higher Learning seeking employment in Singapore
- Parent or grandparent of a Student’s Pass holder studying in Singapore (requires a local sponsor above 21 years old)
- Visitor seeking to give birth in Singapore (requires a local sponsor above 21 years old)

Please note that all the above criteria are not exhaustive. Eligibility is still subject to ICA’s final approval.

- Singapore Citizens with foreign spouses may also be eligible for LTVP Plus (LTVP+), providing a longer period of residency and additional employment and healthcare benefits
- For more information on the [LTVP+ and its benefits, as well as your eligibility for it, please refer here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/news-and-publications/newsroom/media-release/351)

For LTVP+

- No separate application is required. You will automatically be considered for LTVP+ (if eligible) when you apply for LTVP

^ Couples consisting of a Singapore Citizen and a Non-Resident are strongly encouraged to complete their Pre-Marriage LTVP Assessment (PMLA) before marriage. [Learn more about the PMLA here](https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/pre-marriage-long-term-visit-pass-assessment) and [apply for PMLA here](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/evpaa).

## How to apply?
- Submit your application online using the [e-Service](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/evp)
- After receiving the in-principle approval notice for your LTVP application, refer to the [various procedures relating to the Completion of Formalities and the Issuance of Long-Term Visit Pass ](https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/LTVP/cof-and-issue-new)for the next steps
- For further assistance, please contact ICA at [6391 6100](tel:6391-6100) or [submit an enquiry](https://go.gov.sg/ica-ltvp-enquiry)

## What to expect?
- A S$45 non-refundable processing fee is applicable for each application
- Additional fees will apply if the LTVP application is granted in-principle approval
- Applications are generally processed within six weeks, provided all required documents are submitted and in order
- It may take longer for couples who did not complete the PMLA (up to 6 months)
- You will be informed of the application outcome via email and may also check the application status online through [MyICA](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/icsbip) or the [e-Service](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/evp)

title: Permanent Residency
description: Allows eligible foreigners to apply for permanent residency.
embedding_text:
Domains: Citizenship and residency

# Permanent Residency 

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/PR*

Allows eligible foreigners to apply for permanent residency.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** OTHERS
**Keywords:** Fees payable, Long-term

## About this support
- Facilitates the process for eligible foreigners to reside in Singapore on a permanent basis
- Permanent Residents aged 15 and above will be issued the Singapore blue Identity Card (IC)

## Who is this for?
Available for:

- Spouse of a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Unmarried child (aged below 21) born from a legal marriage to / have been legally adopted by a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Aged parent of a Singapore Citizen
- Employment Pass or S Pass holder
- Student studying in Singapore
- Foreign investor in Singapore

Please note that the above criteria are not exhaustive. Individual eligibility is still subject to ICA’s approval.

## How to apply?
- Refer to [ICA's explanatory notes](https://www.ica.gov.sg/reside/PR/apply) and prepare the required supporting documents
- All permanent residence applications must be submitted online using the [e-Service ](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/esvclandingpage/epr)using your valid Singpass account, or your Foreign Identification Number and immigration pass issuance date if you're a student
- For more information on e-Service accessibility, please refer to the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://ask.gov.sg/ica) and [Step-by-Step guide](https://www.ica.gov.sg/docs/default-source/ica/eservices/epr/step-by-step-guide.pdf) in the e-Service
- For further assistance, please contact ICA at [6391 6100](tel:6391-6100) or [submit an enquiry](https://go.gov.sg/ica-pr-enquiry)

## What to expect?
- Processing time for each application is at least 6 months
- You may check your application status online through [MyICA](https://eservices.ica.gov.sg/icsbip)
- A $100 non-refundable processing fee is payable for each applicant at the point of submission of application
- If application is successful, you will need to complete permanent residency formalities personally at the ICA office

# National Service LifeSG Credits

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/NSLSG-CREDIT*

$200 in LifeSG credits for all eligible past and present national servicemen to recognise their contributions to Singapore’s defence and security.

## Highlights
- $200 in LifeSG credits
- For all eligible past and present national servicemen
- Credits have been automatically disbursed to eligible national servicemen in 2024
- Valid for 1 year from the date of disbursement

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Keywords:** Budget 2024, NSFs, NSmen

## About this support
- $200 in LifeSG credits for all eligible past and present national servicemen, accessible via the ‘Your Benefits’ section of the [LifeSG mobile application](https://go.life.gov.sg/5yCp).
- The credits are valid for 1 year from the date of disbursement. The validity period will not be extended.
- Eligible national servicemen may check on the validity period of their credits through the LifeSG mobile application.

**Where to use the NS LifeSG Credits:**

- The credits can be spent at online or physical merchants accepting payments via PayNow UEN QR or NETS QR.
- As a show of support for National Service, several merchants are offering additional discounts and promotions when payments are made using the NS LifeSG Credits. For the list of participating merchants, please refer [here.](https://go.gov.sg/promosnslifesg)

## Who is this for?
- Full-Time National Servicemen (NSFs) who have enlisted by 31 Dec 2024.
- Past and present Operationally Ready National Servicemen (NSmen).

embedding_text:
Domains: Citizenship and residency, Family, parenting and relationships, Financial support and benefits

# NSman Relief  

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/PgRdvYbQ*

Provides tax relief to eligible operationally ready National Servicemen (NSmen) to recognise their contributions to National Service, as well as to the wives and parents of NSmen to recognise the support they give to their husbands or sons.

## Highlights
-  Tax relief provided for NSmen and their wives and parents 

**Who it targets:** Families
**Keywords:** Tax relief

## About this support
- NSman Self Relief of $1,500 to $5,000 for eligible NSmen
- NSman Wife Relief of $750 for the wives of eligible NSmen
- NSman Parent Relief of $750 for each parent of the eligible NSman

## Who is this for?
**NSman Self Relief:**

- Completed full-time National Service under the Enlistment Act or deemed to have completed such service by the proper authority
- Not a regular in the following organisations:
  - MINDEF
  - Singapore Police Force
  - Singapore Civil Defence Force
  - Central Narcotics Bureau
  - Singapore Prison Service
- Have not committed disciplinary or criminal offences in the preceding work year
- If you and your son are both NSmen, you will be eligible for either the NSman Self Relief or NSman Parent Relief, whichever is higher

**NSman Wife Relief:**

- You are a Singapore Citizen in the previous year
- Your husband is eligible for Nsman Self Relief
- Widows of deceased NSmen may also be eligible unless they have re-married

**NSman Parent Relief:**

- You are a Singapore Citizen in the previous year
- Your child is eligible for NSman Self Relief
- Your child was born to you and your spouse or ex-spouse / is your step-child / was legally adopted
- Parents of deceased NSmen are also eligible
- If you and your son are both NSmen, you will be eligible for either the NSman Self Relief or NSman Parent Relief, whichever is higher
- The relief amount per parent is capped at $750, regardless of how many children are NSmen

## How to apply?
No application is required. The relief will be automatically granted based on eligibility.

## Where to go
[Visit your nearest branch](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/locate-us)

## Agency website
[View more details](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/individual-income-tax/basics-of-individual-income-tax/tax-reliefs-rebates-and-deductions/tax-reliefs/nsman-relief-(self-wife-and-parent))

## Email / Form
[Submit an enquiry](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/individual-income-tax)

## Phone number
IRAS hotline: [1800-356-8300](tel:1800-356-8300)

embedding_text:
Domains: Counselling and crisis support, Family, parenting and relationships, Mental health

# Counselling

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/iO9WdkX4*

Provides counselling and psychotherapy to individuals, couples and families facing interpersonal, intrapersonal, and mental health issues.

**Who it targets:** Families, Low-income, Persons with disabilities, Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG
**Keywords:** Counselling, Families

## About this support
**Counselling and therapy services include:**

- Family Therapy
- Couple/Marital Therapy
- Individual Psychotherapy
- Pre-marital counselling and marriage preparation
- Counselling on sexuality and sexual issues
- Counselling and therapy sessions can be conducted in-person or online via Zoom.

**Helplines:**

- Care Corner Counselling Centre also runs a toll-free Mandarin Counselling Hotline at 1800 353 5800 daily from 10am to 10pm, excluding public holidays.
- SAMH Insight Centre also provides a toll-free helpline at 1800 287 7019 (9am to 6pm on weekdays, except 1pm to 2pm and public holidays).

## Who is this for?
Individuals, couples and families with issues such as:

- Marital and relationship issues
- Family and parenting issues
- Grief and loss
- Mental health
- Personal challenges
- Stress
- Trauma

## How to apply?
For enquiries or appointment booking, call or email the respective service provider.

## What to expect?
- The service provider will assess the request for counselling and ask your presenting issues and preferred day/time for the counselling and arrange a slot for you accordingly.
- The staff will also provide information on the fees.
- Counselling intake and assessment is conducted at the first appointment and the client will see the same counsellor for the subsequent sessions until the case is closed or transferred.
- If counselling is not suitable, the counsellor may refer you to other appropriate services.
- A counselling session takes around 1 hour.
- Most issues will need more than 1 counselling session to resolve.
- Fees payable for all service providers except SAMH Insight Centre.

embedding_text:
Domains: Counselling and crisis support, Family, parenting and relationships, Mental health

# Counselling (Seniors)

*Source: https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/services/ceeJSWE0*

Provides counselling to older persons aged 50 and above and/or their caregivers, to improve their mental well-being and resilience to cope with life’s challenges.

**Who it targets:** Seniors, Vulnerable
**Citizenship:** SG
**Keywords:** Counselling, Seniors

## About this support
- Gerontological counselling provides an avenue for seniors and their caregivers to discuss their issues and concerns and help to address their personal, social or psychological challenges.
- Individual and group counselling available.
- Counselling can be provided at the counselling centre or at their own home if necessary.

## Who is this for?
Persons aged 50 years old and above with issues and concerns such as:

- Grief and loss
- Loneliness/isolation
- Depression
- Stress and anxiety
- Relationship problems
- Difficulty adjusting to transitions and changes (e.g. retirement, ‘empty nest’ syndrome, onset of illnesses)

Family members/caregivers who experience stress caring for their elderly loved ones who are experiencing the above-mentioned concerns can also be supported.

Hua Mei Centre for Successful Ageing also provides individual and group coaching in emotion management, inter-generational relationship-building and communication skills.

## How to apply?
For enquiries or appointment booking, call or email the respective service provider.

## What to expect?
- The counselling centre will arrange an appointment for you with a professional counsellor who will assess your needs and advise if counselling is able to meet your needs.
- If counselling is not suitable, the counsellor will refer you to other appropriate services.
- A counselling session takes around 1 to 1.5 hours.
- Most issues will need more than 1 counselling session to resolve.
- Fees payable for Hua Mei Centre for Successful Ageing and O’Joy Limited.
